name: Amaryllis
source:
"Given your presence, esteemed guest, might I interest you in a session of fortune-telling?"

Adorned in stark white, Amaryllis serves as the self-appointed night guardian of the mansion, emerging solely after dusk. Her aversion to sunlight confines her to her dimly lit chamber during daylight hours. Proficient in both pharmacology and fortune-telling, she also diligently monitors Akira’s physical well-being.
